paragraphs: An ongoing Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts has sickened 32 people across six states, with three hospitalizations reported [1]. Several Class I recalls this week include Sempio Food Services Inc. recalling Korean Ginseng Chicken Stew Classic pouches sold in Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Virginia due to import violations [2]. Fontanini Foods LLC is recalling raw, frozen pork sausage links packed on 06/23/2026 and distributed to California, Florida, Michigan, and Nevada because of possible plastic contamination [3]. Taylor Fresh Foods Inc. is recalling Tomato Salsa Fresca sold across 26 states due to potential Salmonella contamination [5]. NatureBest Pre-Cut & Produce is recalling pico de gallo products in Texas and Louisiana because jalapeños may contain Salmonella [6].

Everything Sprouts Crunchy Protein Sprout Mix is recalled in Minnesota and Wisconsin due to potential STEC E. coli and Salmonella [4], and Organic Triple Berry Blend is recalled in Arkansas due to potential E. coli O145:H28 [9]. Mon Sire Brie soft cheese distributed in Florida is recalled for potential Listeria monocytogenes [7], and Foods Alive organic moringa leaf powder sold nationwide is recalled for potential Salmonella [8]. Star Meat Delivery Inc. is recalling A&D Foods goat products produced without inspection [10]. Additional recalls include Deano's Pasta Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli for undeclared lobster [16], Galil Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning for elevated lead levels [17], and Mezzetta Golden Greek Peperoncini for a pest contaminant [15]. Martina brand mangoes and Buckhead tuna are also recalled [11][12].
